channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Kareem Abdul-Jabbar | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Kareem Abdul-Jabbar from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Richard Jefferson on LeBron James, Kobe Bryant, Michael Jordan, Kareem Abdul-Jabbar, Bill Russell
item.description:
Richard Jefferson:

“There is no GOAT in basketball because there's multiple levels. Kareem Abdul-Jabbar I think had the greatest career, Bill Russell won the most championships, Michael Jordan is the icon, and I think Kobe Bryant and what he did mentally for the game and really for athletes all around the world. ButI would just say if you were to build a basketball player, you could not build a better basketball player than LeBron James. There's no skill set he doesn't have, there's no physical ability. So for me, if I was building a basketball player, mentally and physically, he would be the person that I would build.”

Richard Jefferson on LeBron James, Kobe Bryant, Michael Jordan, Kareem Abdul-Jabbar, Bill Russell, Sep 12, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Michael Cooper on Kareem Abdul-Jabbar
item.description:
Who is your GOAT?Cooper:

“My GOAT is Kareem. He is an unstoppable player. You look at three things for a GOAT. One, can they score at any time at any point in the game? Kareem was unstoppable, even double or triple-teamed. If you triple-teamed Kobe, LeBron or Magic when they come across the floor, they’re going to pass the ball. But with Kareem, you couldn’t double or triple team him. He had the Skyhook. Next, a GOAT makes others around him better. Kareem made others better. No one other than Magic made others around them better when they were double or triple-teamed. For a GOAT, if you foul, will he make his free throws? Kareem shot in the 80s in crunch-time free-throw shooting. So that’s why Kareem is my GOAT.”

Michael Cooper on Kareem Abdul-Jabbar, Jul 16, 2026. Source: Fade Away World.

item.title: Jerry Stackhouse on Michael Jordan, Kareem Abdul-Jabbar
item.description:
Jerry Stackhouse:

“I mean, from some skill standpoints, he’s probably better. He’s a better ball handler than Michael Jordan was. I think he’s a better facilitator than Michael Jordan was. Was he a better scorer than Michael Jordan? No. Was he a better clutch performer? No. Michael Jordan went to the Finals six times, won six championships, six Finals MVPs. So, to me, he’s always going to be the GOAT in my book. No matter what people might think, what might have happened in Washington, or where we didn’t see eye to eye, Michael Jordan is still the greatest player to ever put on a pair of basketball shoes in my mind. And I’m probably going to put Kareem after that.”

Jerry Stackhouse on Michael Jordan, Kareem Abdul-Jabbar, May 12, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Klay Thompson on Tony Parker, Manu Ginobili, Michael Jordan, Scottie Pippen, Magic Johnson, Tim Duncan, Kareem Abdul-Jabbar
item.description:
Thompson:

“That’s one of the greatest partnerships ever. You can compare it to peanut butter and jelly. They’re one of the greatest duos of all time. No question about it. They won four championships together. You have to win championships together to be compared to Scottie Pippen and Michael Jordan or to Magic Johnson and Kareem Abdul-Jabbar or Tim Duncan and Manu Ginobili and Tony Parker. They are definitely in that category or that conversation.”

Klay Thompson on Tony Parker, Manu Ginobili, Michael Jordan, Scottie Pippen, Magic Johnson, Tim Duncan, Kareem Abdul-Jabbar, Nov 12, 2024. Source: SportsKeeda.

item.title: Michael Cooper on Kareem Abdul-Jabbar, Jamaal Wilkes, Norm Nixon
item.description:
“And when I walk into the gym I see Kareem Abdul-Jabbar and Jamaal Wilkes and Norm Nixon. So, we get into practice and stuff. Jerry pulls me to the side and he goes, ‘Coop, I already have scorers. I got 30 points in Kareem. I got 27 to 28 from Jamaal Wilkes. I got 22 to 25 in Norm Nixon. There is not enough balls to go around for you to get shots. So, I need somebody to play defense.’“So, I said, ‘Hey, I already got the fundamentals down. I got the aggressiveness down.’ And now I’ve been told that this was going to be my role. So, I took that to heart, embraced it, got better and better.”

Michael Cooper on Kareem Abdul-Jabbar, Jamaal Wilkes, Norm Nixon, Oct 9, 2024. Source: Andscape.

item.title: Ralph Sampson on Kareem Abdul-Jabbar, AC Green, Artis Gilmore, Terry Cummings, Victor Wembanyama
item.description:
Ralph Sampson:

“Victor Wembanyama’s a different player at a different time of basketball. He’s got great skills. He’s got great work ethic with what you can tell, but he don’t have to play the post, and if he did it’d be a different ball game. But there’s not big guys who can play against him. He’s playing against little people, so the game is totally different. We had to play against guys here like Terry Cummings, A.C. Green, Kareem (Abdul-Jabbar), Artis Gilmore, you got real men that will beat your a-- in the post.”

Ralph Sampson on Kareem Abdul-Jabbar, AC Green, Artis Gilmore, Terry Cummings, Victor Wembanyama, Sep 14, 2024. Source: Arizona Republic.

item.title: Mychal Thompson on Kareem Abdul-Jabbar
item.description:
Mychal Thompson:

“Mainly that this was home. He grew up here basically, and he idolized Kobe. Kobe was his man and basketball idol, and it would’ve been cool just like how I finished my career with my basketball idol in playing with Kareem Abdul-Jabbar. That’s who I grew up idolizing. I was able to play alongside him and play in the same uniform as him. I thought that would be a fitting end for Klay to play in Kobe’s uniform and for the franchise that Kobe represented. That would’ve been a nice bookend to his career. But it wasn’t meant to be, so be it.”

Mychal Thompson on Kareem Abdul-Jabbar, Jul 3, 2024. Source: SportsKeeda.

item.title: James Worthy on Magic Johnson, Kareem Abdul-Jabbar, Nikola Jokic
item.description:
SportsComedyRap: James Worthy on greatness of Jokic:

“To me Jokic is Magic Johnson & Kareem on the floor at the same time.”

James Worthy on Magic Johnson, Kareem Abdul-Jabbar, Nikola Jokic, Apr 22, 2024. Source: Twitter.

item.title: James Worthy on Kareem Abdul-Jabbar
item.description:
Worthy continued,

“And he looked at Kareem and said, ‘Kareem, what would you like to do?’I mean, he just knew who to push and who not to push, and he knew when you needed it.”

James Worthy on Kareem Abdul-Jabbar, Aug 17, 2023. Source: Sports Illustrated.

item.title: Shaquille O'Neal on Kareem Abdul-Jabbar
item.description:
Shaq responded:

“Listen, you not speaking to me was the best thing that happened to my career because all I ever wanted to do was impress you, sir. I will talk to you soon, inshallah, and I love you very much. I will never ever have beef with the great Kareem Abdul-Jabbar. You ain’t got to worry about that.”

Shaquille O'Neal on Kareem Abdul-Jabbar, Feb 8, 2023. Source: Los Angeles Times.

item.title: Darvin Ham on Kareem Abdul-Jabbar
item.description:
Darvin Ham on Kareem:

“It was beautiful to watch him growing up ... just the way he seamlessly functioned on the court, he was built basically like today's athlete. Long, wiry, athletic...”

Darvin Ham on Kareem Abdul-Jabbar, Feb 7, 2023. Source: Twitter @MirjamSwanson.

item.title: Pat Riley on LeBron James, Kareem Abdul-Jabbar
item.description:
“Training, travel, personal chefs, personal trainers, all that stuff has come into play since Kareem. I hope people realize Kareem’s story as well and how different it was. He went to college for four years; LeBron came out of high school. But they both dominated from Day 1. They both turned potential into greatness from Day 1.”

Pat Riley on LeBron James, Kareem Abdul-Jabbar, Feb 1, 2023. Source: Associated Press.

item.title: Pat Riley on Kareem Abdul-Jabbar
item.description:
Unlike most of the NBA, however, Riley has seen this kind of late-career dominance before: from Abdul-Jabbar.

“I always said that Kareem was the greatest player of all time because of his longevity,”

Pat Riley on Kareem Abdul-Jabbar, Jan 24, 2023. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Pat Riley on Kareem Abdul-Jabbar
item.description:
“Kareem was unique from the standpoint that he could play at a high level, play 80 games a year ... get beat up because of double- and triple-teams and guys just taking shots at him. He just developed this mental toughness along with a great physical body to really last forever.”

Pat Riley on Kareem Abdul-Jabbar, Jan 24, 2023. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Dirk Nowitzki on Michael Jordan, Kareem Abdul-Jabbar
item.description:
He even went a step further, weighing in on the GOAT debate.

“Ialways say Michael Jordan is the GOAT, but if James surpasses Kareem Abdul-Jabbar with the scoring record, I’m sort of running out of arguments for Michael,”

Dirk Nowitzki on Michael Jordan, Kareem Abdul-Jabbar, Dec 26, 2022. Source: EuroHoops.net.

item.title: LeBron James on Kareem Abdul-Jabbar
item.description:
“I mean, I love Kareem too. I can’t even front on that, but Shaq’s so dominant, we need a big cuz I’m playing the 4, so we need a big. A.D. already put himself in the Top 5? Well put A.D. in, take me out.”

LeBron James on Kareem Abdul-Jabbar, Sep 28, 2022. Source: Lakers Daily.

item.title: LeBron James on Kareem Abdul-Jabbar
item.description:
LeBron James on nearing Kareem Abdul-Jabbar’s scoring record:

“I’m kind of in awe of it, like, ‘Wow.’ … To sit here and to know that I’m on the verge of breaking probably the most sought after record in the NBA … it’s super humbling”

LeBron James on Kareem Abdul-Jabbar, Sep 26, 2022. Source: Twitter @mcten.

item.title: Jeanie Buss on Kareem Abdul-Jabbar, Chick Hearn
item.description:
“We have something that is coming up, which is he will probably become the all-time leading scorer in the history of the NBA, which would break Kareem Abdul-Jabbar’s record. Which, I’ll never forget when he did that, and Chick Hearn said, ‘This is a record that will never be broken,’ and here we are, somebody who is going to break it in a Laker uniform. And that has a lot of meaning to the organization, and to me personally,”

Jeanie Buss on Kareem Abdul-Jabbar, Chick Hearn, Sep 10, 2022. Source: Sports Illustrated.

item.title: Frank Vogel on LeBron James, Kareem Abdul-Jabbar
item.description:
Frank Vogel on LeBron passing Kareem:

“To me he's the greatest player ever to play. ... I still believe he's going to lead us to great things this year.”

Frank Vogel on LeBron James, Kareem Abdul-Jabbar, Feb 13, 2022. Source: Twitter @RyanWardLA.

item.title: LeBron James on Kareem Abdul-Jabbar
item.description:
LeBron on passing Kareem:

“Throughout my career, whenever I've been linked with some of the greats I've been in awe.”

LeBron James on Kareem Abdul-Jabbar, Feb 13, 2022. Source: Twitter @RyanWardLA.

item.title: Bill Walton on Kareem Abdul-Jabbar, Ralph Sampson, Artis Gilmore
item.description:
“It allowed me to develop skills that I would need as I moved up to each new level of competition. …“Later, when I found myself matched against the tallest players in the game, Kareem Abdul-Jabbar, or Artis Gilmore or Ralph Sampson, I could step out to the perimeter, forcing them to come guard me. More times than not, that opened passing lanes for others to score.”

Bill Walton on Kareem Abdul-Jabbar, Ralph Sampson, Artis Gilmore, Nov 18, 2021. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Eric Holder on Kareem Abdul-Jabbar, Muhammad Ali
item.description:
“It’s the kind of thing that maybe for too long athletes got away from that activist image. I grew up with Jackie Robinson, Muhammad Ali, Kareem Abdul-Jabbar. Guys who were unafraid to take risks, to try to express themselves to move the nation in a better way. It is great to see these young NBA players embracing that heritage and using their voices to bring the nation along. So, as I said, I’m proud of them,”

Eric Holder on Kareem Abdul-Jabbar, Muhammad Ali, May 7, 2021. Source: NBC Washington DC.

item.title: Shaquille O'Neal on Kareem Abdul-Jabbar
item.description:
“I remember when I was averaging 30-35 in that way but we always get swept. The great Kareem Abdul-Jabbar said ‘Hey, he hasn’t won a championship yet.’ Did I whine? Did I cry? Did I complain on social media? No, I didn’t say anything because Kareem Abdul-Jabbar had G-14 classification to say that. Am I going to have a dispute with the greatest NBA player ever?“So when he said that when he gave me constructive criticism, I took it and I listened and I brought my game to another level. So these guys now they’re pudding pops. You say something about them… that’s what they are.”

Shaquille O'Neal on Kareem Abdul-Jabbar, Mar 2, 2021. Source: TalkBasket.

item.title: Wayne Embry on Kareem Abdul-Jabbar
item.description:
And then Embry added:

“We asked Kareem if there was dissatisfaction with us and he said, no, he just wanted to be traded from Milwaukee. He said his lifestyle and the lifestyle in Milwaukee were not compatible.”

Wayne Embry on Kareem Abdul-Jabbar, Dec 11, 2020. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Isiah Thomas on Kareem Abdul-Jabbar, Julius Erving
item.description:
Thomas recalled explained.

“My focus was Bird, Magic, Dr. J [Julius Erving], Kareem Abdul-Jabbar. Those were the guys. I don't care what anybody says. You can go back and look at history — those were the guys.”

Isiah Thomas on Kareem Abdul-Jabbar, Julius Erving, Nov 12, 2020. Source: CBSSports.com.

item.title: Caron Butler on Kareem Abdul-Jabbar
item.description:
“Kareem, arguably the greatest player to ever play the game of basketball, he walked out and a lot of people did not know who he was.”

Caron Butler on Kareem Abdul-Jabbar, Jun 18, 2019. Source: Wisconsin State Journal.

item.title: Etan Thomas on Oscar Robertson, Kareem Abdul-Jabbar, Bill Russell
item.description:
“He said no and that he values athletes using their voices and values athletes using their platforms,and talked about the history of athletes using their platforms like Bill Russell, Kareem (Abdul-Jabbar), Oscar Robertson.”

Etan Thomas on Oscar Robertson, Kareem Abdul-Jabbar, Bill Russell, Feb 22, 2019. Source: Arizona Republic.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Kareem Abdul-Jabbar
item.description:
Gregg Popovich:

“We see it in our politics every day. We see it in so many different venues across the country, such divisions. And it just seems that there is a large group of people who as Kareem (Abdul-Jabbar) said today, probably good people who are just pretty ignorant of facts and unable to walk in somebody else's shoesand an inability to become as I've said before uncomfortable and take for granted the advantages that one has and actually believes deserved.”

Gregg Popovich on Kareem Abdul-Jabbar, Oct 17, 2018. Source: San Antonio Express-News.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Kareem Abdul-Jabbar
item.description:
Only 12 players have multiple Finals MVP honors, with Magic Johnson, Willis Reed, Larry Bird, Kareem Abdul-Jabbar and Tim Duncan being the others.

“Kobe, M.J., LeBron, Kareem, those dudes drive me, they push me every day to get to that level, to that standard and I want to be able to sit back and talk to them about basketball one day,”

Kevin Durant on Kareem Abdul-Jabbar, Jun 9, 2018. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on Michael Jordan, Magic Johnson, Karl Malone, Kareem Abdul-Jabbar
item.description:
“I played with Michael Jordan when he was 39 he played 37 minutes a night. Karl Malone was 37, played 38 minutes a night, Kareem Abdul-Jabbar, Magic Johnson, Kobe. Everybody's built different. If you're one of the greats, sometimes you've got to play, sometimes you get rest like tonight.”

Tyronn Lue on Michael Jordan, Magic Johnson, Karl Malone, Kareem Abdul-Jabbar, Nov 21, 2017. Source: Cleveland Plain Dealer.
